2608.16344.title: IndicQE-APE: A Benchmark for Quality Estimation and Automatic Post-Editing for Indic Languages
2608.16344.paper_summary: Indic quality estimation (QE) and automatic post-editing (APE) data is spread across separate releases, so no single resource supports training and evaluation across tasks and language pairs on one footing. We consolidate the WMT 2020--2024 shared-task lineage with an extended English--Malayalam resource into \indicqe: $126{,}754$ instances over nine directional pairs, with up to four label types aligned on the same segment, a direct assessment, a human post-edit, word-level OK/BAD tags and an error explanation, and a test set stratified over four difficulty axes. On it, we benchmark six prompted LLMs and three COMET metrics on segment-level QE, and three systems on APE. Two of the axes are defined partly on the direct assessment and select a compressed slice of it, so each axis is compared against a control drawn from the same language pair with the same score distribution. Only one survives that control: segments whose holistic and token-level quality signals conflict are ranked worse than equally-scored segments of the same language, for all nine systems and all seven pairs that carry the axis. Annotator disagreement, which looks second-hardest without the control, has no effect with it. Few-shot prompting costs every model $\leq$ $3.4$B both correlation and output-format compliance. Within-language accuracy does not make scores comparable across pairs: of the three trained metrics, the one with the best within-language correlation loses most when the pairs are pooled. The benchmark and code will be released.
2608.16344.paper_summary_zh: 指標質量評估（QE）和自動後編輯（APE）數據分散在不同的版本中，因此沒有單一資源可以在一個基礎上支持跨任務和語言對的訓練和評估。我們將 WMT 2020--2024 共享任務的血統與擴展的英語--馬拉雅拉姆語資源整合，形成 \indicqe：$126{,}754$ 個實例，涵蓋九個方向對，最多有四種類型的標籤對齊在同一段落上，包括直接評估、人類後編輯、單詞級 OK/BAD 標籤和錯誤解釋，並且測試集在四個難度軸上進行分層。在此基礎上，我們在段落級 QE 上基準測試六個提示的 LLM 和三個 COMET 指標，並在 APE 上測試三個系統。兩個軸部分基於直接評估並選擇其壓縮切片，因此每個軸都與來自相同語言對且具有相同分數分佈的控制進行比較。只有一個在該控制中存活：整體和標記級質量信號衝突的段落，其排名低於相同語言的同等得分段落，對於所有九個系統和所有七個承載該軸的對。標註者之間的分歧在沒有控制的情況下看起來是第二難的，但在有控制的情況下沒有影響。少量提示對每個模型的成本均為 $\leq$ $3.4$B，無論是相關性還是輸出格式合規性。語言內的準確性並不使得分數在對之間可比：在三個訓練指標中，具有最佳語言內相關性的指標在對合併時損失最大。基準和代碼將被發布。
